driver_archetypes.rationale: Compliant car drivers (Saval et al. 2023) with low acceleration/deceleration and high time headway; no red-running rules applied.
Passive car drivers drawn from 'car' distribution; p=0 for queue_space_seeking ensures they do not block right-turn lanes.
Compliant motorcycle drivers (Saval et al. 2023) with low lateral gap; eligible for red-running and early-start rules.
Passive motorcycle drivers drawn from 'moto' distribution; eligible for space-seeking and red-running rules.
Illegal left-turning motorcycles (distribution moto_violator); jmTimegapMinor=0.5 reduces box hold time to match M6/junction/illegal_l/moto timing.

traci_rules.rationale: Maintains 50% red-light running probability for motorcycles at the stop line to match M3/share/moto (observed 0.098) and M4/overshoot_share (observed 0.62).
Targets M2/early/moto (observed mean 0.1302 share): increased p and v_max allows more motorcycles to creep over the stop line in the last 2s of red to reduce overshoot_depth mismatch.
Activates sidewalk riding (p_sidewalk=0.75) and wrong-lane usage (p_wrong_lane=0.25) to match M10a (0.56 veh/cycle) and M8/moto (wrong-lane share 0.249), reducing queue length impacts.
High bypass probability (0.8) allows motorcycles to pass standing U-turners, reducing delay and matching field observations of aggressive maneuvering; reduced t_wait to 1.5s.
Low bypass probability (0.1) for cars reflects their reluctance to change lanes past U-turners.
